generate_docstring_for_code: use the Writer agent to generate a docstring for a given code component with context
check_if_class_component: check if a code component is a class definition using is_class_component
extract_docstring_from_llm_response: extract the docstring from an LLM response wrapped in XML DOCSTRING tags
get_custom_prompt_for_component: get the appropriate system prompt for a class or function code component
initialize_writer_agent: initialize a Writer agent with an optional config path for LLM-based docstring generation
